### common headers: from/sender

*  `From: name1 <user1@host1>, name2 <user2@host2>`
*  `Sender: name <user@host>`
<hr/>
*  identify sender of message, but...
   *  not required to match `MAIL FROM:` command

### common headers: to/cc

*  `To: name1 <user1@host1>, user2 <user2@host2>`
*  `To: GroupA: user1 <user1@host1>, user2 <user2@host2>; GroupB: user3 <user3@host3>, user4 <user4@host4>`
*  Similar for `Cc` ("carbon copy")
<hr/>
*  identify receipients of message, but...
   *  not required to match `RCPT TO:` command

### common headers: Bcc

*  `Bcc: name3 <user3@host3>, name4 <user4@host4>`
<hr/>
*  "blind carbon copy"
   *  extra recipients not seen
*  _removed_ before actually sending via SMTP

### Bcc implementation options

*  simpliest: remove Bcc header, RCPT TO everyone
   *  issue: Bcc recepients don't know why they got message
*  alt 1: replace header with `Bcc: Undisclosed recipients: ;` or similar
*  alt 2: separate mail transactions for each Bcc recepient <br/>
   replace header with <pre>Bcc: <i>that receipient</i></pre>
